harness_rev_note: FULL RE-RECORD 2026-09-06 (shadow-oracle flake round): the whole golden is one --plane all pass of the published 1.5.5 binary (48e2800c...), not a patch on an older one. WHY IT MOVED: the recorder used to leave busbar's plugin staging dirs behind, so whichever boot came next swept them and printed '[info] removed N orphaned plugin staging dir(s)' into ONE random boot-log cell per run; the recorder now gives busbar a private per-run TMPDIR and sweeps dead-pid staging dirs itself before every boot, so no cell records which cell ran before it. Two independent full 1.5.5 recordings under that fix agreed on 896 of 897 cells byte-for-byte, with no boot-log cell differing; the 897th (llm|bedrock|responses|request|ok_stream) is the declared accepted difference for the latencyMs the mock's binary eventstream frame carries. admin.ops|GetHooksNameStatus|ok comes from a pass under the FINAL harness (6c243f42...), which gates a hooks boot on the headroom hook having answered once: without that gate the cell recorded either the drift report or 'hook did not answer status' depending on the machine. No cell was hand-edited. | Earlier note: RE-STAMPED 2026-09-06 (oracle-phase0 golden pass, after 8dd5c068 + f7bbca20): NO cell was re-recorded for this stamp and no cell's bytes changed — every cells/*.json, the ledger and `recorded` are exactly as the merge below left them. The rev moved because cells.json did: those two commits lifted each cell's Appendix B parity rows out of its `why` prose into a `bindings` list and restored three `inventory` citations, touching 164 cells' DOCUMENTATION fields. Proven not to reach a recording: with `why`, `bindings` and `inventory` stripped from both revisions, all 2299 cells are identical field-for-field, and the id list is unchanged. Previous rev 44b21569bb7a is now the last entry of harness_rev_history. | Earlier note: RE-RECORDED 2026-09-06 (oracle-phase0 golden pass): 34 cells, taken from a FULL record.sh --plane all of the SAME published 1.5.5 binary (48e2800c...) under harness_rev 44b21569; the other 862 cells are untouched and still reflect harness_rev 1083031798 (now in harness_rev_history). WHY THESE 34: 33 moved because the HARNESS CONFIG changed, not the binary. f5d0b0bb added the sibling budget group broke-quota, a fourth minted key (oracle-quota) and a second per-boot priming request to oracle-config.sh/record.sh, which (i) shifted every config.yaml line number by +4, moving the 'at line N column M' suffix of 14 --validate refusals (boot.refusal BOOT-P01/P12/P13/P14/P31/P32/P33-P40 validate; neutrality NEUT-U-top/models/providers validate), (ii) added the group:broke-quota@day bucket rows to /metrics (ops.scrape metrics key; crosscut.traps request-duration-quantiles), (iii) counted one more request on lane 6 in /stats (ops.scrape stats key; neutrality routes stats; neutrality stats-idle-zero; documented changelog stats-reasons; http.crosscut bearer-and-x-api-key), and (iv) added the fourth key, the third group and one audit row to the admin views (admin.ops GetKeys ok, GetGroups ok, GetPools ok, GetPoolsName ok, GetUsage ok, GetUsage no-usage-after-mutation, GetAudit ok; billing admin-usage after-2 and past-day). The 34th, plugins.store-persist store-sqlite, moved because d769a714 gave record.sh the exec.paths strip the exec driver already had: its old cell quoted the CI runner's own absolute recording paths back into its effects, so the norm-rule set carried exec.paths on one side only. No cell was edited by hand and no cell was recorded from anything but the published 1.5.5 binary. WHY FROM A FULL RUN, NOT A --filter RUN: a cell whose answer depends on state earlier cells left (the governance store, the metrics buckets) records DIFFERENTLY under a filter -- a filtered re-record of ops.scrape metrics key carried a group:oracle-added@day bucket that no full run has at that point -- so these came out of a full --plane all pass and were verified stable across two independent full 1.5.5 runs. TWO CELLS WERE DELIBERATELY NOT RE-RECORDED: documented readme tls-mtls and neutrality boot-lines differ between two full runs of the SAME binary by one boot-log line, '[info] removed 1 orphaned plugin staging dir(s) left by a crashed prior run' -- leftover state in the recorder's own tree, not behaviour. Their checked-in cells (the no-leftover form) stand. The recorded count also corrects a stale 885 that was never bumped as cells were added: the golden holds 896 PASS cells and now says so. | Earlier note: 6 cells added (oracle Phase 0, group-BUDGET-total arm): a new sibling group `broke-quota` (budget cap ONLY, no requests cap) and its QUOTA key/priming request in oracle-config.sh/record.sh, plus the new `over_budget_total` outcome enumerated in enumerate-cells.py, changed the harness revision. Three harness changes moved the hash: (1) harness-rev.sh's own file set gained apply-mutation.py and scripts/*.py (scripts/apply-deferred-decisions.py) — both decide what an exec/script cell is recorded against, and neither was in the revision that names how a recording was made; (2) cells.json grew 10 SKIP-able cell DEFINITIONS the round-3 audit named (six llm|<d>|<d>|request|stream_upstream_error, billing|key-usage|refund-across-window, http.crosscut|413|{mcp-streamable-http,a2a-jsonrpc,gemini-path}) — definitions only, all needs_fixture except the gemini 413, none recorded here, so they read as named golden gaps until the integrator re-records from the published 1.5.5 binary; (3) mock-upstream.py gained the `stream-error` control verb those six cells need, which fires only under the control header on an already-streaming request and leaves every happy-path stream builder byte-identical. capture.py's audit-delta fix is in the hash too and is a no-op on this golden (its audit deltas are 0/1/11 — nowhere near the `?limit=1000` page the fix is about). PREVIOUS NOTE: 3 cells hand-replaced from fresh single-cell recordings against the SAME golden binary (48e2800c...) after two harness fixes: (1) scripts/documented-validate-checks.sh resolved BUSBAR_BIN and RAW to absolute paths before step4's `cd "$W/s4"` -- previously a relative --bin or --out made step4's own `busbar --validate` invocation (or its stdout/stderr redirects) fail before/without ever running busbar, which is why the old golden's step4_bare_path_exit was "1" with EMPTY stderr; the real 1.5.5 behavior is exit 0 with the BUSBAR_PROVIDERS deprecation warning, now reflected in documented|changelog|validate-checks; (2) normalize.py gained a `ts.usage-window` rule (window.start/window.end under a `window` object -> 0) so admin.ops|GetUsage|ok and admin.ops|GetUsage|no-usage-after-mutation no longer pin the UTC-day boundary the recording happened to be made on. renormalize.sh could not be used because this golden's raw/ captures are not checked in; each of the 3 cells was replaced by hand from `record.sh --filter <cell-id>` output.
